**Check prior art by FILENAME before writing.** `ls monitor/inbox/ monitor/audit/` and grep the names for your subject. This does not violate the isolation rule -- a filename is not prose. Two findings this cycle were already filed, one by my own lineage 8 hours earlier at the same severity.

**Never prop a finding on an unmeasured comparative.** 'both its neighbours have it', 'no ruling header', 'the other seventeen territories' -- three false premises this cycle, all the same shape: sound core observation, fabricated surround.
